Index: .gitignore
===================================================================
--- .gitignore	
+++ .gitignore	
@@ -0,0 +1,33 @@
+target/
+!.mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.jar
+!**/src/main/**/target/
+!**/src/test/**/target/
+
+### IntelliJ IDEA ###
+.idea/
+*.iws
+*.iml
+*.ipr
+
+### Eclipse ###
+.apt_generated
+.classpath
+.factorypath
+.project
+.settings
+.springBeans
+.sts4-cache
+
+### NetBeans ###
+/nbproject/private/
+/nbbuild/
+/dist/
+/nbdist/
+/.nb-gradle/
+build/
+
+### VS Code ###
+.vscode/
+
+### macOS ###
+.DS_Store

Index: pom.xml
===================================================================
--- pom.xml	
+++ pom.xml	
@@ -0,0 +1,55 @@
+<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
+<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
+         xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
+         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 https://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
+    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>
+
+    <parent>
+        <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
+        <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-parent</artifactId>
+        <version>4.1.1</version>
+        <relativePath/>
+    </parent>
+
+    <groupId>com.example</groupId>
+    <artifactId>demo</artifactId>
+    <version>0.0.1-SNAPSHOT</version>
+    <name>demo</name>
+    <description>Spring Boot project with testing support</description>
+
+    <properties>
+        <java.version>21</java.version>
+    </properties>
+
+    <dependencies>
+        <dependency>
+            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
+            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-webmvc</artifactId>
+        </dependency>
+
+        <!-- Testing support: JUnit 5 (assertions), Mockito (mocking),
+             AssertJ (assertions) and the Spring TestContext framework. -->
+        <dependency>
+            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
+            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-test</artifactId>
+            <scope>test</scope>
+        </dependency>
+
+        <!-- Test slices such as @WebMvcTest and MockMvc. -->
+        <dependency>
+            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
+            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-webmvc-test</artifactId>
+            <scope>test</scope>
+        </dependency>
+    </dependencies>
+
+    <build>
+        <plugins>
+            <plugin>
+                <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
+                <artifactId>spring-boot-maven-plugin</artifactId>
+            </plugin>
+        </plugins>
+    </build>
+
+</project>

parts.text:
Confirmed: `spring-boot-starter-web` is deprecated in favor of `spring-boot-starter-webmvc` in Spring Boot 4. I'll use `spring-boot-starter-webmvc`.

Now Java version: Spring Boot 4 requires Java 17 minimum. Let me use Java 21 (LTS) or 17. Spring Boot 4 baseline is Java 17, supports up to 25 maybe. I'll use Java 21 LTS as a safe modern choice. Actually with date 2026, Java 25 is LTS (Sept 2025). Spring Boot 4 supports Java 17-25. Let me use 21 to be safe and widely available. Hmm, but proper. Java 21 is fine.

Now let me create the project. Structure:

